errors.evidence: The tick labels on the y-axis are 2.0, 2.2, 2.4, 2.6, 2.8, and 3.0, which means they are spaced at intervals of 0.2, not 0.1.

While the magenta line does start around this value, at iteration 95000 it is the lowest of the three SepLLM lines. The description incorrectly reports starting values that reverse the initial order of the lines (blue > orange > magenta).
The magenta line ends at a value slightly below 2.2, closer to 2.18.
The blue line (SepLLM n=128) starts at a loss value of approximately 3.0 at iteration 95000, not 2.9.
The blue line (SepLLM n=128) ends at a loss value of approximately 2.25 at iteration 125000, not 2.2.
The orange line (SepLLM n=64) starts at a loss value of approximately 3.0 at iteration 95000, not 2.85.
The orange line (SepLLM n=64) ends at a loss value of approximately 2.28 at iteration 125000, not 2.2. This makes it appear to converge with the other lines when it does not.
